children: Navigator Global Investments' September-quarter performance looks mixed to its bull at Morgans. Analyst Richard Coles likes the 9% growth in group ownership-adjusted assets under management, which was led by the Australian alternative-asset manager's strategic portfolio. Less positive was a slowdown in net flows at its Lighthouse portfolio, with flows mostly into lower-margin managed accounts. These Lighthouse net flows were largely offset by negative performance, he adds in a note. On balance, he says Navigator remains well positioned to benefit from structural tailwinds in global alternative asset markets. Morgans keeps a buy rating on the stock and a target price of 3.04 Australian dollars. Shares are up 0.2% at A$2.095. (stuart.condie@wsj.com)
